prerequisites: "Data Processing for Engineers" or "Introduction to Programming (for Engineers)"

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the structure and functioning of programmable logic controllers (PLCs).
Apply the graphical programming languages "Ladder Diagram" and "Function Block Diagram" according to the DIN EN 61131-3 standard for algorithms of simple complexity.
Structure, develop, and test PLC programs for various model systems.
Identify implementation problems with regard to a program design and develop solutions.

syllabus_topics: Introduction and overview of the function and structure of PLC hardware
Familiarization with a PLC development environment
Use of the communication interface to the PLC
Understanding the connection of PLC and experiment board/model system via circuit diagrams

assessment_methods.method: Experiment reports / program listings including commentary
Explanation of programs in the testat

bibliography: Braun, Werner: Speicherprogrammierbare Steuerungen. Praxisnahe Aufgaben und Lösungen mit STEP 7, Vieweg Studium Technik: Wiesbaden (3. verb. Auflage) 2005.

Seitz, Matthias: Speicherprogrammierbare Steuerungen für die Fabrik- und Prozessautomaten. Strukturierte und objektorientierte SPS-Programmierung, Motion Control, Sicherheit, vertikale Integration, Carl Hanser Verlag: München (4. überarb. und erweit. Auflage) 2015.
